evidence.asymmetricFeatures: Pinned KiCad H1/H2 are X -7.5/+7.5 mm and Y +16 mm in imported PCB coordinates. The STEP PCB has 2.65 mm mounting-hole rims at X -7.5/+7.5, Y -2.5, Z 0..1.6 mm; the stated translation maps both centers exactly.
